title: Goal Governance project config (VP-004 R3)
description: Committable project pin for the configurable governance root. Only the root prefix is configurable; the internal layout under the root is frozen.

governance_root.description: Repo-relative governance root (default: docs). Absolute paths and '..' escapes fail closed; internal layout (vision/, workspace-*, goal-tree, five-piece shape) is not configurable.
